text:
Introduction
This document
lists the equipment inspection I2, which must be performed on an annually bases 
as indicated by Y1
 in the title block
The first draft 
initiated by Mr. Helmut Canadian SISP, S/S specialist, and first approval at 2 
Sep 1996, first review date 03 March 2002, 
and second review date 15 Jan. 2006.
The document was updated by 
Ataka PS.
Safety Precautions
A work 
 permit must be issued,
The qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable ID safety category,
Safety fence 
 with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Appropriate personal protective equipment must be used, i.e. safety shoes, 
 helmet, breathing mask, safety glasses.
